vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill

This OpenClaw skill bundle provides a legitimate integration with the Ahrefs API for SEO analysis. All `curl` and `Invoke-RestMethod` examples consistently target the official `https://api.ahrefs.com/v3/` endpoint. The skill correctly instructs users to configure their `AHREFS_API_TOKEN` in `~/.openclaw/workspace/.env`, and the provided shell/PowerShell snippets (e.g., in `SKILL.md`, `INSTALL.md`, `references/quick-reference.md`) use standard commands like `grep`, `cut`, and `date` to access this token and format dates, which is expected behavior for an API skill. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, obfuscation, or prompt injection attempts against the OpenClaw agent in any of the analyzed files.
